rationale: C23 supplies a concrete amendment template closely matching the child: both amend an earlier executive order through the formula that the referenced order or provision “be, and it is hereby, amended,” and then prescribe the membership of a federal board or authority by listing designated officials. C25 has related amendment-and-membership machinery but enlarges an existing committee by adding only one representative. C08 parallels the composition of a presidential body, but it creates a new board rather than amending an earlier directive.

shared_material.child_excerpt: [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of October 9, 1934, as amended, be, and it is hereby, further amended to provide that the National Capital Housing Authority shall be composed of the following-designated officials
shared_material.parent_excerpt: paragraph 1 of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of November 13, 1947 ... be, and it is hereby, amended to read as follows
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same distinctive operative formula to amend an earlier directive's membership provision.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall be composed of ... The President of the Board of Commissioners ... the Director of Planning ... the Chairman ... and three additional officials to be designated by the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of State, the Secretary of the Treasury, the Secretary of Defense, the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Secretary of Commerce, and the Secretary of Labor are hereby designated to be members of the Board.
shared_material.explanation: Each replaces or prescribes the body's composition through an enumerated list of government officials.
